author: Stahly
description:
Not every wargame needs a hundred publications to keep track of and a dedicated app to manage your army list. One Page Rules built their reputation on exactly that idea, and now their flagship sci-fi ruleset Grimdark Future has its first physical starter set with PVC miniatures. We're reviewing the Grimdark Future Starter Set, which pits the undead-robot-esque Robot Legions against the sci-fi lizard warriors of the Saurian Starhost across 51 pre-assembled miniatures, a complete ruleset, terrain, and a gaming mat. Everything you need to play, in a single box.

The post Impressive pre-assembled PVC minis: OPR Grimdark Future Starter Set unboxing appeared first on Tale of Painters.
title: Impressive pre-assembled PVC minis: OPR Grimdark Future Starter Set unboxing
